items.headline: Nine UK hosepipe bans in force; Southern Water consults on wider non-essential use ban
items.summary: Home-washing bans push volume to commercial sites, but a Southern Water non-essential use ban could restrict business vehicle washing outright.

items.headline: More than 100 German cities and districts impose water-use restrictions in drought
items.summary: Restrictions are now widespread across a core IMO market, raising the odds German sites face throttled or suspended washing.

items.headline: Southern Water applies for drought order that would ban mechanical vehicle washing
items.summary: A non-essential use ban would close commercial car washes outright in Hampshire and the Isle of Wight, not merely restrict hosepipes.

items.headline: UK car washes allowed to keep trading through hosepipe restrictions
items.summary: Temporary use bans hit domestic washing but carve out commercial sites, which can push drivers from driveways onto forecourts.

items.headline: Munich decree bans washing cars at home, permits commercial washes, fines up to EUR 50,000
items.summary: Drought rules across Munich and seven neighbouring municipalities route car washing to professional sites only — direct volume tailwind for German estates.
